run.change_description:
fix(redis2): remove orphaned directory index members on listing

ListDirectoryEntries skipped index members whose value key was gone and
left them in the ZSET, so the per-directory child index grew without
bound under any TTL workload. Mirror the ZRem the logical-expiry branch
already performs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---

fix(redis2): keep the index member when a concurrent insert recreates the value

The orphan cleanup removed the member unconditionally, so an InsertEntry
landing between FindEntry and the ZRem left a live value with no index
member, invisible to listings until another InsertEntry on that path.
UpdateEntry does not re-add it, so the loss persisted.

Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal.
The value key and the directory index key hash to different slots, so a
Lua script or MULTI over both is not available to the cluster store.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

summary.intent: Stop the redis2 per-directory ZSET child index from accumulating members whose value key is gone (chiefly Redis-expired TTL entries) by removing them during ListDirectoryEntries, while restoring a member if a concurrent InsertEntry recreates the same path during the cleanup window.
summary.issue_fit: No linked issue; judged against the caller-supplied PR description (spec-seaweedfs-pr10735) and the two real commit messages. Both stated behaviors are implemented, but the second commit's own restorative write can silently fail, undermining the exact guarantee it exists to add.
summary.coverage: Both changed files read in full, plus the full pre-existing universal_redis_store.go for InsertEntry/UpdateEntry/DeleteEntry/FindEntry context. No other files touched. One verification batch dispatched and accounted; no follow-up needed.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go vet ./weed/filer/redis2/...` offline at 6c8fde664: clean, no diagnostics.
Reviewer ran `gofmt -l` on both changed files at 6c8fde664: no output, both already formatted.

Reviewer ran `go test -v -count=1 ./weed/filer/redis2/...` offline at 6c8fde664: all three new tests SKIP (no RUN_REDIS_TESTS / live Redis in this sandbox, matching their own gating), package result `ok`; assertions verified by tracing setup/call/assertions instead of execution.

PR body's own reported `go build ./weed/...`, `go vet`, `gofmt`, and `go test ... -race` against a live Redis 8.2.1, and its pasted master-vs-fix failing-test output, are self-reported prose, not a readable CI artifact; the live-Redis and -race portions and the full `./weed/...` build cannot be reproduced offline in this sandbox (no Redis server, no network, other modules unavailable), so they are recorded as unused and not relied on.

findings.title: Check the restorative ZAddNX result in removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember
findings.trigger: A concurrent InsertEntry recreates the value while this cleanup is removing its member; after ZRem and EXISTS confirm the value is back, this function's own repair `ZAddNX` errors (timeout, reset, cluster MOVED/ASK) and the result is discarded.
findings.impact: The member is never restored: the entry has a live value but no index member, invisible to ListDirectoryEntries and DeleteFolderChildren until an unrelated future insert on the same path — the exact loss commit 6c8fde6 exists to prevent, reached via a dropped reply instead of the original race.
findings.change: Check this ZAddNX's error the way the ZRem above it already does, log it, and retry once before giving up — it is idempotent (NX), and per this commit's own note no cross-slot transaction can guarantee the write any other way.
findings.source: commit-6c8fde6/"Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal."

observations.fact: The pre-existing logical-expiry branch a few lines above (TtlSec check) also discards its Del/ZRem results without checking, unchanged by this diff and outside its scope.

requirements.source: commit-6c8fde6/"Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal."
requirements.evidence: weed/filer/redis2/universal_redis_store.go:245-250 implements the restore, and a fresh-context verifier confirmed the design converges correctly whenever every Redis command succeeds (premise-orphan-cleanup-converges: holds), but the restorative ZAddNX at line 250 discards its own error, so the restore itself can silently fail; see finding redis2/orphan-restore-zaddnx-error-unchecked.

requirements.source: pr-body/"Rebuilding it unprefixed would have been a silent no-op for every deployment that sets keyPrefix"
requirements.evidence: universal_redis_store.go:178,208,237-250 reuse the already-prefixed `dirListKey` parameter throughout; never rebuilt unprefixed. universal_redis_store_test.go runs TestListDirectoryEntriesRemovesOrphanedIndexMembers under both keyPrefix="" and keyPrefix="sw:".

requirements.source: pr-body/"The branch guard is err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound — identity, not errors.Is"
requirements.evidence: universal_redis_store.go:97-102 (FindEntry) returns the bare filer_pb.ErrNotFound sentinel only for redis.Nil, wrapping every other error with fmt.Errorf; line 207's `err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound` comparison is unchanged by this diff.

universal_redis_store.go:63-65 (InsertEntry) and :132-134 (DeleteEntry) skip ZAdd/ZRem for super-large directories, so their index key never exists; ZRangeByLex at :189-194 then returns no members and the new cleanup path at :208 is unreachable for those directories.

requirements.source: pr-body/"the failure modes bias towards a stale member rather than a lost one"
requirements.evidence: A fresh-context verifier confirmed the ZRem-error path (returns immediately, no partial state) and the EXISTS-error path (falls through to attempt a restore) both bias toward keeping a member, but the restorative ZAddNX's own unchecked error instead biases toward losing one — see finding redis2/orphan-restore-zaddnx-error-unchecked, which this assertion's exception qualifies as a defect.

tasks.premise: Absent any Redis command failure, removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember's ZRem-then-EXISTS-then-ZAddNX sequence converges to a consistent state (member present iff the value key is present) under any interleaving with a concurrent InsertEntry on the same path, because InsertEntry always writes the value before its own ZAddNX adds the member back.
